subject: english
question:
What is the meaning of the word "epochal" as used in the context:

"....each epochal shift reflects broader socio-technological metamorphoses."
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3)** i.e. **Highly significant or defining**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"epochal"** refers to something that is uniquely important, momentous, or influential enough to form a new era or "epoch" in history. (महत्वपूर्ण या युगांतरकारी)

 
 
• **Example: **The invention of the internet was an epochal event that changed how the entire world communicates.
 
 
 
• **"Highly significant or defining" **captures the essence of an epochal shift, which isn't just a small change but one that defines a whole period of time or a major transition in society. (अत्यधिक महत्वपूर्ण या निर्णायक)
 
 
• **Example: **The transition from manual labor to industrial machinery was a highly significant or defining moment in human history.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is- **Highly significant or defining**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ancient **(प्राचीन): Belonging to the very distant past and no longer in existence.

 
 
• **Example:** Archeologists recently discovered the ruins of an ancient city buried beneath the desert sands.
 
 
 
• **Minor **(मामूली ): Lesser in importance, seriousness, or significance.
 
 
• **Example: **The software update included only minor bug fixes and no major new features.
 
 
 
• **Predictable** (पूर्वानुमेय): Behaving or occurring in a way that is expected and not surprising.
 
 
• **Example:** The plot of the romantic comedy was quite predictable, ending exactly how everyone thought it would.
 
 

37:Tfc6,
The correct answer is '**Option 2**'.<
